causal_chain: Each perturbed transaction starts a full trial from the same committed/checkpoint state.
HeadCalc exhausts the configured eight Newton iterations without satisfying convergence.
On normal loop exhaustion HeadCalc resets trial soil state, sets fldecdt and request_dt_reduction, and increments the worker internal-retry diagnostic.
The F-SI legacy binding maps fldecdt or request_dt_reduction to SW_SOLVE_RETRY_ADVISED with route legacy-reference-retry.
The serialized reference backend returns from advance before setting outcome.solver_ok when the solve status is not SW_SOLVE_CONVERGED.
execute_reference_interval sees full_outcome.solver_ok=false, increments solver_rejections and immediately reject-and-retries the transaction.
Because rejection occurs on the full trial, the two-half branch, transaction mass acceptance and temporal acceptance are not reached for these attempts.

With max_retries=2 there are three full-trial attempts. Three times eight Newton iterations gives 24 nonlinear iterations; four maximum backtracking attempts per Newton iteration gives 96 backtracking attempts.
not_established: No mass-balance rejection is established as the cause.
No temporal-comparator rejection is established as the cause.
No production solver defect is established because the perturbations are diagnostic extrapolations outside the scientifically admitted fixture.

next_useful_action: Characterize the nonlinear convergence boundary itself using observer-only diagnostics or a source-bound diagnostic probe.
